$comment: ARIA SMART Objective — Teams Action.Submit payload schema reference
When the Teams bot receives an Action.Submit from the smart-objective card it must:
1. Read the 'action' field to route the request.
2. For action == 'copy': invoke Teams clipboard API (desktop) or display a
copy-friendly TextBlock (mobile). No API call is needed.
3. For action == 'regenerate': resolve the instruction text — if 'regeneratePreset'
has a non-empty value use it, otherwise use 'regenerateInstruction' — then POST to
/api/chat with the body shown in 'regenerateApiRequest' below. The bot must forward
the user's Entra bearer token (the same token used for the initial chat turn) in the
Authorization header.
The 'objective' and 'previousObjective' fields are the full SmartObjective JSON object
serialised as a string by the card template and parsed back to an object by the bot before
the API call. Do not pass them as raw strings to the API. A request may set at most one of
previousDraft or previousObjective — never both.
Desktop vs mobile differences
Desktop Teams: Action.Submit fires automatically when the user clicks 'Copy objective',
picks a quick-refinement choice, or types an instruction and clicks 'Refine'.
Mobile Teams: same card renders in a single-column layout. The Input.ChoiceSet and
Input.Text for the regenerate instruction stack below the SMART breakdown. Behaviour
is identical.

copyPayload.$comment: Payload the bot receives when the user clicks 'Copy objective'.

objective.objectiveText: Reduce average time-to-hire for engineering roles from 45 to 30 days by 31 December 2026.
objective.achievable: Builds on the recruiting process improvements already underway
objective.relevant: Supports the team's hiring priority for this year

regeneratePayload.$comment: Payload the bot receives when the user clicks 'Refine' after choosing a quick preset.

previousObjective.objectiveText: Reduce average time-to-hire for engineering roles from 45 to 30 days by 31 December 2026.
previousObjective.achievable: Builds on the recruiting process improvements already underway
previousObjective.relevant: Supports the team's hiring priority for this year

$comment: The POST body the bot sends to POST /api/chat after receiving a 'regenerate' action.
Authorization: Bearer <user-entra-token> (same token as the original chat turn).
Content-Type: application/json

$comment: Shape of the ChatResponse the API returns for a regenerate request.
The bot maps smartObjective back to a new smart-objective.json card and updates the card in the channel.
regenerateApiResponse.message: Here is a revised objective with a clearer measurable target.
